description: Nuxt 3+ full-stack Vue engineering: universal Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), file-based routing, Nitro engine, reactive composables, and SEO meta tags.
instructionsMarkdown:
# Nuxt 3+ Full-Stack Vue Engineering

Build ultra-fast, SEO-optimized universal Vue 3 web applications powered by Nuxt 3 and Nitro.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Use `useAsyncData` and `useFetch` to prevent client-server hydration mismatch anomalies.
- Isolate SSR reactive state per request using `useState` instead of global client-side singletons.
- Configure Nitro server routes with strict CORS and rate-limiting route rules.
- Maintain reactive SEO metadata using `useSeoMeta` and OpenGraph tags.
